newsitem.title: USA: Adeza Biomedical closed $13 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Adeza Biomedical closed $13 mln financing.

text.p: Adeza Biomedical Corp said on Monday it had closed a $13 million round of financing through the sale of Series 3 convertible preferred stock to an investor syndicate led by The Sprout Group.
Prudential Securities acted as the agent for the offering, it said.

"We believe that this financing will provide the company with funding well into 1998 enabling the company to increase its domestic and international sales efforts and fund research, development and clinical trials for new products," it said.
Adeza Biomedical is a Sunnyvale biotechnology company that develops, manufacturers and markets biomedical products.
